title: Resource Board KPI is a percentage between 0 and 100
description: The Resource Board's headline value is passRate = round(compliantResources/totalResources*100), an outcome metric (design doc D1 fix), not a raw resource count — it must never render as a raw count or exceed 100%.
steps: Open /dashboard and read the Resource Board's headline KPI value
expectedResult: Value is formatted as 'N%' with 0 <= N <= 100.

title: Every one of the 6 board cards opens its real board content, never the generic 'coming soon' fallback
description: AuditOverviewContent's workspace panel maps selectedBoard to one of ComplianceBoardContent/ExecutiveResourceBoardContent/VendorBoardContent/ExecutiveRiskBoardContent/AuditBoardContent/FrameworkBoardContent; anything unmatched falls through to a plain '... content coming soon' text node.
steps: Click each of the 6 board cards in turn, returning to Overview between each
expectedResult: Each click renders its dedicated board content component; the 'coming soon' fallback text never appears for any of the 6 named boards.

title: The dashboard auto-refreshes on a stable 5-minute interval without stacking duplicate timers
description: AuditOverviewContent sets a single setInterval(fetchMetrics, 5*60*1000) in a useEffect keyed on [fetchMetrics] and clears it on cleanup — re-renders must not leave multiple overlapping intervals firing concurrently requests.
steps: Open /dashboard and leave the tab open, monitoring the Network tab for calls to /api/dashboard/metrics
Wait through at least 2 refresh cycles (~10+ minutes) while interacting with unrelated filters
expectedResult: Exactly one /api/dashboard/metrics call fires per 5-minute window from the auto-refresh timer (independent of any manual filter-triggered calls) — never 2+ simultaneous auto-refresh calls.

title: Vendor Board's untracked metrics show a 'Pending' badge, never a fabricated 0
description: 'Critical dependencies' and 'Avg trust score' in the Vendor Board's bottom metrics are marked pending:true with a pendingReason because their backing vendor fields (businessInfo.criticalVendor, riskProfile.singlePointOfFailure, securityInfo/performanceMetrics) don't exist on any real vendor document yet.
steps: Open the Vendor Board and inspect the 'Critical dependencies' and 'Avg trust score' rows
expectedResult: Both rows show '—' with a dashed 'Pending' badge; hovering reveals a tooltip explaining the missing backing field — neither row shows a numeric 0 or 100.

title: CarAgingChart shows an explicit zero-state message instead of an empty chart
description: CarAgingChart (Audit Board) buckets overdue CARs into 0-30d/31-60d/61-90d/90+d and shows a red '<n> overdue' badge; when all buckets are 0 it must show 'No overdue corrective actions' rather than a blank/empty bar chart.
steps: Open the Audit Board for a project with no overdue corrective actions
expectedResult: The card shows the text 'No overdue corrective actions', not an empty bar chart with a '0 overdue' badge and no explanation.

title: The Retry button after a failed metrics load reissues the call with the currently active filters
description: The error Alert's Retry button calls fetchMetrics(effectiveFilters) — the filters state at the moment of failure — not a hardcoded default filter set.
preconditions: A non-'all projects' filter and a date range are already applied
Backend temporarily returns an error for /api/dashboard/metrics
steps: Apply a date-range filter and a single-project selection
Force the next /api/dashboard/metrics call to fail (e.g. simulate a 500)
Click Retry on the resulting error Alert
expectedResult: The retried request still carries the same date range and project selection, not the default 'all projects, all time' filter set.
